notes:
Seti Astro Suite Pro

V1.23.0
New in-house blind solving! Nothing new to download, but the quad databases will need to be built from your already downloaded gaia data. Settings->Gaia Local Library->Blind Solve Index. Recommended layers are highlighted to build, only takes a couple minutes.

Plate Solver option to Force Blind solve. Plate solver is also optimized for very fast plate solving.

Solves some very tough fields that other solvers fail on! This makes ASTAP completely optional now for using SASpro

This is completely cli callable too, as it is a VERY powerful offline plate solver. See the cli help for more information, example: setiastrosuitepro.exe --help, or python setiastrosuitepro.py solve --help

Other updates include: Perfect Palette Picker Linear Output! (much requested), improvements to NBExtract, addition of common descriptors in the smart naming convention, and other bug fixes.
